summary: This video showcases an Incandescence team speedrunning major dungeons using level 79 heroes. The lineup consists of Anneliesis, Talethia, Lincos, Diantha, and Journ. The team achieves rapid clear times across multiple boss stages, including Grave of Venom in 7 seconds, Grave of Curse in 12 seconds, Grave of Rot in 11 seconds, and Heretical Ruins in 10 seconds. The showcase highlights the extreme burst damage capability of full Incandescence synergies.
